svg.aria-label: Start C4 + E4, end C4 + F4. The lower voice holds C4. The upper voice moves from E4 to F4, up 1 semitone. The pair changes from a major third (4 semitones) to a perfect fourth (5 semitones).
svg.title: One voice moves: a major third becomes a perfect fourth

g.text: How to read this graphic: The dashed square
is where the upper voice started (E4) and the
arrow shows its single step to F4. The lower
voice, the circle on C4, does not move. The
keys are coloured for the pair where you
finish, and the two badges name the start and
